subject.title: fix(discord): bound stalled probe response reads

question: Should the Discord probe adopt the proposed 16 MiB body cap and idle-timeout semantics, including omission of stalled optional application metadata, or should maintainers require a stricter total response deadline first?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically valid, but the permanent probe timeout and degradation contract is an owner-level availability choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Accept the bounded idle reader
options.body: Refresh onto current main, rerun the controlled production-path proof, and merge if the final diff and behavior remain unchanged.

options.title: Require a total deadline
options.body: Pause the PR and extend the implementation so continuous slow-trickle bodies cannot outlive the caller’s total timeout.

options.title: Keep existing behavior
options.body: Close the PR only if maintainers intentionally prefer unbounded successful-body reads over fail-fast probe degradation.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded idle reader
recommendation.body: Refresh onto current main, rerun the controlled production-path proof, and merge if the final diff and behavior remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They prepared the current implementation, added the application and status-budget behavior, and supplied the maintainer-side proof context.
